text:
Asha: hey @channel — weird one: my upstairs neighbor started a salsa class at 7pm and the bass is rattling my ceiling. anyone dealt with this? looking for quick fixes (white noise apps, cheap soundproofing hacks, neighbor convo scripts). also, i just assembled a tiny ikea shelf and now cords are in a sad spaghetti pile 🤦‍♀️
Mike: ugh been there. rugs + filled bookshelves against the shared wall helped for me. also cheap foam panels dampen mid/highs :thumbsup:
Zoe: white noise + a box fan works. myNoise app has solid presets. pink/brown noise cut through bass better than spotify playlists for me :speaker_with_cancellation:
Ben: try a polite DM first — "hey, your class sounds fun but the bass travels into our unit, any chance of lowering it after 7?" 9/10 it works. if it's regular, building mgmt can mediate. :slightly_smiling_face:
Asha: thanks. any specific white-noise presets or cheap gear? Spotify brown noise felt too weak against the bass
Mike: try the myNoise "Powerful Brown Noise" preset or the fan on the lowest setting. cheap moving blankets hung on the shared wall help a surprising amount. DIY tip: ```hang blanket on heavy-duty 3M hooks, leave ~2" gap from wall so it doesn't fungus the paint``` :sweat_smile:
Zoe: mass-loaded vinyl is the proper solution but $$$. rent-friendly: rug, couch, bookcase, and blankets in that order. also sealing the gap under the door helps low end a bit.
Ben: if it gets worse, file a polite noise complaint with the office/building. try neighbor chat first though — people usually tone it down when asked.
Asha: tempted to start salsa upstairs just to mess with them lol. will try fan + moving blanket tonight and report back :grin:
reverb-bot: saved "white-noise-recs" to pinned resources in #random
Mike: pro tip: noise-cancelling headphones + a good podcast saved my sanity during a 3-week construction hell. cheaper earbuds with ANC are surprisingly decent now :headphones:
Zoe: share that ikea cord pic when you can — cable-grommet hacks incoming :eyes:
